title: MV SRD Timed Attack prevent Secondary Effects on failure

posts.author: jakes0110
posts.body: I am working on a game that uses SRD’s Timed Attacks. There are certain skills that I made with certain secondary effects, like defense drops and inflicting silent. The problem: whenever I fail the prompt, there is no damage, but the attack still inflicts the secondary effect when I don’t want it to. Is there a notes command or something extra that would prevent both no damage AND no secondary effect on failure?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
